subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Is the current extracted terminal proof enough to accept this PR as the canonical fix for the empty-error retry bug, or should it wait for full-runner/gateway proof and conflict resolution first?
rationale: The code shape is plausible, but proof sufficiency, the SDK-exported result field, server-error retry-before-failover behavior, and the dirty merge state require maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Require proof and rebase first
options.body: Ask for a redacted full-runner or gateway run showing the retry warning, recovered reply, and no duplicate side effects, then review the rebased conflict-free diff.

options.title: Accept the current proof
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly own the proof gap and compatibility semantics if they consider the extracted terminal transcript and tests sufficient.

options.title: Use another canonical PR
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers prefer the still-open same-root candidate at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97966 as the landing path.

recommendation.title: Require proof and rebase first
